rationale:
Issue #1461 reports tall-style output where a parameter carrying multiple annotations plus a default value got its continued annotations and the parameter itself over-indented and split at the `:` separator. The fix commit states the mechanism and the diff matches it: visitDefaultFormalParameter no longer builds the AssignPiece (ast_node_visitor.dart), and the new writeDefaultValue helper builds it inside pieces.withMetadata(...) in writeParameter, so metadata wraps the whole parameter-plus-default instead of forming the AssignPiece left-hand side. The trigger fixture test/tall/regression/0300/0387.unit is the issue's reproducer verbatim; its expected output changes from the misindented form to the corrected form and the `### TODO(1461)` marker is deleted. 0247.unit shows the same annotation-plus-default indentation correction. The minimized production patch touches only the two front_end files; the writeFunctionType restructuring is required rather than unrelated, since the removal of the assignment from visitDefaultFormalParameter forces function-typed formals to pick up the default value from the parent node, and the NormalFormalParameter -> FormalParameter signature widening in writeFormalParameter is needed for the same parent lookup. No formatting-only, documentation-only, or configuration-only hunks appear. The triggers are .unit data fixtures consumed by the pre-existing test/tall_format_test.dart harness, so they introduce no dependency on a production API added by the fix. Strict evidence records both original and post-minimization gates passing, with reproduced triggers metadata.unit, 0247.unit, and 0387.unit failing on the buggy revision and all fixed runs green across 3 repetitions and 50 matrix runs. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no registry entry, and dart-lang/dart_style#1461 is the only allowed id.

Issue #1461 reports concrete wrong tall-style output for parameters carrying both metadata and a default value: continuation annotations over-indented and a needless split at the ':' separator. The fix commit (referenced by 'Fix #1461' in both commit message and PR #1478 body, traceability path fix_commit_to_issue) addresses exactly that root cause: visitDefaultFormalParameter no longer builds the AssignPiece with the metadata-bearing parameter as its left side; instead writeDefaultValue constructs the AssignPiece inside pieces.withMetadata(...) in writeParameter/writeFunctionType so metadata wraps the whole parameter-plus-default rather than the assignment's left-hand side. The reproducing trigger tall/regression/0300/0387.unit is the verbatim 'greet(...)' reproducer from the issue, and its expectation drops the '### TODO(1461): The indentation is wrong here.' marker, confirming the exact reported symptom. The minimized production patch touches only lib/src/front_end/ast_node_visitor.dart and lib/src/front_end/piece_factory.dart; the writeFunctionType restructure and the NormalFormalParameter->FormalParameter signature widening are required consequences of relocating default-value handling into the parameter writer (function-typed formals can also carry defaults), and the doc-comment edits describe the new defaultValue parameter, so no unrelated refactor, feature, config, or docs-only change is present. Triggers are fixture data files (.unit) driven by the pre-existing test/tall_format_test.dart harness, so they depend on no production API introduced by the fix. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization runs passes every gate: build.both_versions, selectors.present_and_unique (4/4), trigger.buggy_differential with reproduced selectors tall/function/metadata.unit, tall/regression/0200/0247.unit, tall/regression/0300/0387.unit, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (5 fingerprint groups), matrix.repetitions >= 3, and full_suite.fixed_all_green. active_same_same_project_root_causes is empty, so #1461 is not a duplicate of any active registry entry.
